cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I know this board game. I'm opening with the horse in the lake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. I'm testing the scoring environment first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not allowed to move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We have established a stable scoring environment.
